# KELA — Messages from the Trees

> KELA is the original spiritual-reflection work of Tree Medium Patti, published by Lumen Pleroma LLC. The site offers a private Tree Message service plus free animal, tree, and plant oracle decks and nature memory games.

## Primary pages

- [Tree Medium Patti and private Tree Messages](https://treemedium.vercel.app/): Service, method, Patti biography, booking flow, and frequently asked questions.
- [Oracle Card Meanings](https://treemedium.vercel.app/oracle-card-meanings): Hub for 54 original KELA oracle meanings.
- [Animal Oracle Card Meanings](https://treemedium.vercel.app/animal-oracle-card-meanings): All 22 original animal meanings and confirmation reflections.
- [Tree Oracle Card Meanings](https://treemedium.vercel.app/tree-oracle-card-meanings): All 12 original tree meanings, botanical names, attunements, and reflection questions.
- [Plant Oracle Card Meanings](https://treemedium.vercel.app/plant-oracle-card-meanings): All 20 original plant meanings, botanical names, and meditation prompts.

## Interactive experiences

- [Free Animal Oracle](https://treemedium.vercel.app/animal-oracle)
- [Free Tree Oracle](https://treemedium.vercel.app/tree-oracle)

- [Animal Guide Bug Quest](https://treemedium.vercel.app/animal-adventure)

## Important context

- KELA card meanings are original interpretations for spiritual reflection and personal growth.
- They do not claim universal, Indigenous, religious, supernatural, or medical authority.
- Oracle content is not a prediction, diagnosis, treatment, or command.
- No plant card is advice to ingest or apply a plant.
- Contact: treemedium@proton.me
